Introduction to Cabarrus County Superior Court

Cabarrus County Superior Court is a trial court located in Cabarrus County, North Carolina. It is part of the state's General Court of Justice, which also includes the District Court and the Court of Appeals. The Superior Court serves as the court of general jurisdiction, handling a wide range of civil, criminal, and administrative cases.
